April 2026 Social Security payments are scheduled based on birth dates: April 8 (1st–10th), April 15 (11th–20th), and April 22 (21st–31st). SSI recipients are paid on April 1, while those who began benefits before May 1997 or receive both SSI and Social Security will receive payments on April 3. April 2026 Payment Schedule April 1 (Wed): Supplemental Security Income (SSI) payments. April 3 (Fri): Beneficiaries who began receiving benefits before May 1997 or receive both Social Security and SSI. April 8 (Wed): Birthdates 1st–10th. April 15 (Wed): Birthdates 11th–20th. April 22 (Wed): Birthdates 21st–31st. Key 2026 Information COLA Increase: Social Security benefits in 2026 include a 2.8% cost-of-living adjustment. Average Payment: Average retirement benefits are estimated to increase to roughly $2,071 per month. Missing Payments: If a payment does not arrive on the scheduled date, it is recommended to wait three additional mailing days before contacting the Social Security Administration (SSA). Social Security Administration (SSA) Maximum Taxable Earnings: The limit increases to $184,500.
